title: Swarm task orchestration: task model / store trait / retry / acceptance / DAG / timeout

findings.title: require_grounding is enforced on the two tool faces only; the teams.workflow.approve_step RPC twin has no grounding gate and no grounding param, so the Panel approve button voids a control the tool DESCRIPTION and leader prompt promise
Manual hard-retry re-arms the retry budget but never clears retry_not_before, so all four retry faces are silently deferred by the pending automatic backoff (up to retry_backoff_cap_secs)

check_no_cycle_sync is structurally constant-true (always called with a freshly generated uuid, edges immutable) and every cycle test exercises the #[cfg(test)]-only duplicate, so the production path is untested and costs an O(V) BFS under the global DB mutex per create

count_failed_attempts has zero consumers repo-wide while its doc claims to be the dispatcher's single source; it is the anchor-blind spelling of budget_failures_since, so any future reuse reintroduces the exhausted-budget bug the anchor fixed
render_acceptance_section is the only handoff section with no byte cap; criteria are unbounded in count and length and interior newlines pass through, forging authoritative lines in the member prompt

CoordTaskStore no-op defaults fail OPEN on a trait with one implementor: list_task_runs -> Ok(vec![]) yields failed_attempts = 0, which is exactly the value the dispatcher refuses to guess, producing an unbounded zero-backoff retry loop for any future backend
reviewer_kind / reviewer_id are caller-asserted on the RPC review face (the tool face derives both), so an approval can be permanently attributed to the lead agent or to another agent's id
create_task drives BEGIN/COMMIT by hand: a failing COMMIT returns Err with the transaction still open on the connection shared with SqliteSnapshotStore, poisoning every later write until restart

verified_clean: retry path does not bypass acceptance: completion_status re-reads lead_review_required per attempt (dispatcher/schedule/select.rs:33)
both metadata-patch boundaries use merge_metadata_patch (task_manage/update.rs:145, gateway/handlers/teams/tasks.rs:148)
backoff/jitter math: shift guarded at 63, saturating multiply, cap applied, band [delay/2, delay] for all seeds
all epoch timestamps in these paths are seconds on both producer sides (store/helpers.rs:5, dispatcher/schedule/mod.rs:241)
snapshot restore recreates dependency edges in topological order via create_task (teams/snapshots/operations.rs:328)
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON is set by migrate() and the sole production construction site migrates before publishing the handle
no unwrap/expect/panic sites outside #[cfg(test)] in the five reviewed files
